title: platform-objects sys_user: the 2FA display (chip, list column, view tab, Security heading) shows a dead "No" on every deployment where twoFactor is off
body:
Filing gate ①: class (c), a declared display with no working capability behind it. Measured by the `repo:cloud#1` seat's dev on objectstack-ai/cloud#3160 (report comment `6350327150` there). It comes from the maintainer's ruling on cloud#3125: 2FA is either offered, or not shown where it is not wired. Filed by `repo:cloud#1` (seat post #6026, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the objectstack lane. objectstack-ai/cloud#3160 is `Blocked-by:` this card and picks it up with a pin bump.

## Measured (framework pin `9d13b5fc`, objectui `616df659`, local stack)
- `plugin-auth` resolves `twoFactor = OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR ?? plugins.twoFactor ?? false` (`auth-manager.ts:3366`–`:3370`). The control plane sets neither, and `/api/v1/auth/config` serves `features.twoFactor: false`.
- Even so, `platform-objects` shows a 2FA state with no way to act on it:
  - the `sys_user` record page highlights chip 「Two-Factor Enabled: No」 (`pages/sys-user.page.ts:131`);
  - the Security tab's 「Two-Factor Authentication」 heading and caption sit above an empty quick-actions bar (`:405`–`:435`);
  - the list columns and a 「2FA Enabled」 view tab (`identity/sys-user.object.ts:673`, `:690`, `:705`–`:714`).
  This shows on every deployment with the default `twoFactor: false`.
- A deployment cannot hide it. There is no user-page analogue of `registerOrganizationRecordPage`, and `requiresFeature` gates only actions and params, not fields, columns, tabs or page components.

## Wanted (the smallest honest shape; the lane may choose the contract shape instead)
- **Shape 1 (S):** drop `two_factor_enabled` from the `sys_user` highlights chip and from the default list columns. Show the Security tab's 2FA block only when 2FA is enabled, and retire or gate the 「2FA Enabled」 view tab.
- **Shape 2 (M):** extend `requiresFeature` from actions and params to field display, view columns, tabs and page components, fail-closed like actions. It is the stronger contract, but a new authorable surface. Take it only if the whole class should close now.
- If the gate uses a `visibleWhen` over `features`, note that a faulting predicate fails open (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25267 is the sibling).

## Acceptance
- With `twoFactor` off, a user's own `sys_user` record, the user list and its tabs show no 2FA state.
- With it on, the Security tab shows the state and its enable action.

## Related, outside this card (objectui; the cloud seat cannot file there)
- With `twoFactor` on, `enable_two_factor`'s `visible` predicate throws in objectui's `record_section` scope (`features` is not bound there), so the enable button never renders.
- objectui's login page has no second-factor step: a user who enrolled through the API is silently stuck on `/_console/login`. Any deployment that turns 2FA on today locks enrolled users out.
